sources.quote: Xunzi 荀子 (third century BCE) was a Confucian philosopher
would indicate a year of birth sometime around 310 BCE
All we can surmise of his death is that it must have been after 238 BCE
He was born in the state of Zhao in north-central China around 310 BCE
Xunzi 荀子 (third century BCE) was a Confucian philosopher

claims.text: summary: Tính người là ác, điều thiện do con người làm ra

sources.quote: Human xing is evil; what is good is artifice.
“Artifice” (wei)[5] refers to all the traits and habits that we acquire through our own conscious actions

claims.text: summary: học tập và lễ nghĩa chuyển hóa bản tính

sources.quote: There must be the transformation [brought about by] the methods of a teacher and the Way of ritual and morality
Xunzi is known for his belief that ritual is crucial for reforming humanity’s original nature

claims.text: summary: trời chỉ là tự nhiên vận hành

sources.quote: Xunzi is notable for having probably the most rationalistic view of Heaven and the supernatural in the early period
Interestingly, though Xunzi has this rational view of Nature

claims.text: influence: han-phi (tuan-tu ảnh hưởng tới han-phi)

sources.quote: Among his former students were some of the most influential men in politics, including Han Fei 韓非 (d. 233 BCE)
This increased acceptance of the necessity for punishments may have influenced Xunzi’s student Han Feizi

notes: IEP ghi c. 310—c. 220 TCN; SEP ghi sinh khoảng 310 và chỉ biết mất sau 238. Bản ghi theo SEP ('sau 238'), trường died -238 là cận dưới; ổn với nhãn.
